career.summary: Senior PM at a Series-B fintech, transitioning into AI-product strategy.
patterns: Tends to over-invest in research before shipping; ships strongest after time-box.
career.recent_insight: Shipping smaller cuts faster has been more useful than monolithic launches.

health.summary: Consistent sleep, light cardio, recurring shoulder pain since 2025-Q4.
patterns: Pain flares correlate with long laptop sessions on weekends.

growth.summary: Reads ~2 books/month, mostly cognitive science and decision making.
patterns: Gets the most value from books when paired with weekly written reflection.

cross_dimension_patterns.pattern: Health pain reduces output 2-3 days later in career dimension.

failure_learnings.context: Q1 launch overran by 6 weeks because user research was open-ended.
failure_learnings.lesson: Always time-box discovery phases to ≤2 weeks.

long_term_summaries.summary: Year of consolidation: kept the same job, deepened PM craft, started a habit of weekly written reflection.
